_about: Fit of the bundled art (ADR 030) to each SRD creature, judged by eye from contact sheets on 2026-11-06, and the subject of the prompt that replaces it. score: 1 = unrepresentative and far from a fantasy RPG look, 10 = a perfect illustration. kind: photo, artwork (painting, engraving, vase, statue), portrait (Battle for Wesnoth) or icon (game-icons.net). Dragons of the chromatic and metallic families take their subject from scripts/bestiary/art_catalogue.py. Read by art_catalogue.py.
